limitations.title: GBD 2023 Values Are Modelled Estimates
limitations.detail: IHME GBD 2023 deaths, DALYs, and ASRs are modelled epidemiological estimates rather than directly observed vital registration counts; all forecasts and Pareto evaluations must carry uncertainty intervals (lower, val, upper).

limitations.title: All-Age Burden Rather Than 5-Year Age-Specific Trajectories
limitations.detail: The final repository compromise uses aggregated all-age burden counts and age-standardized rates (ASRs) rather than five-year age-specific HAP-COPD burden trajectories.

limitations.title: Adapted Poisson Rate GLM Instead of Full APC Decomposition
limitations.detail: Consistent with aggregated all-age burden, the adapted Poisson GLM models aggregated rates with a log-population offset rather than full Age-Period-Cohort (APC) identifiability decomposition.

limitations.title: Proxy Sex-Specific Burden Projection
limitations.detail: Clean-cooking rollout programmes rarely disaggregate adoption by sex. Stage 3 and MDP model sex equity via a proxy female-to-male exposure elasticity ratio (sex_elasticity_ratio_f_to_m) applied to the shared unit coverage increment.

limitations.title: Uncertainty in Intervention Effectiveness & Fuel Stacking
limitations.detail: Field cookstove trials show substantial fuel stacking and non-linear GBD exposure–response concavity: raw 32–50% PM2.5 reductions for improved biomass translate to much smaller COPD PAF gains (~0.15–0.30). Real-world uptake also varies stochastically.

limitations.title: Household vs. Population Coverage Denominator Bridging
limitations.detail: WHO SDG 7.1.2 is population-denominated (people) whereas surveys (NFHS-5, NPHC 2021) and programme subsidies target households. Observed HH coverage exceeds population coverage by +0.7 to +4.2 pct pts because larger households disproportionately use solid fuels; Stage 3 links them via coverage_bridge_factor (central 1.0, tested 0.8–1.2).

limitations.title: Intervention Costing Boundaries & Unresolved Infrastructure Capex
limitations.detail: PMUY LPG reflects public-fiscal subsidy, whereas improved biomass and induction benchmarks initially reflect hardware/O&M or lack central cash subsidies. Regional rural feeder/transformer + LPG depot capex (infra_lpg_grid) and pooled 2-country budgets remain unresolved gaps (null) and are never invented.

limitations.title: Forecasting Structural Continuity & Scenario Framing
limitations.detail: Stage 2 statistical/ML forecasts assume historical associations persist (with clean-fuel access as the primary driver) and cannot establish causal policy impact. All optimisation and planning outputs are exploratory scenario analyses—never real-world policy prescriptions.

Run 1,000-rollout equal-footing GA vs MDP vs PDDL comparison
Regenerate site/data/*.json and site/downloads/* (read-only on repo)
Launch static research platform locally at http://localhost:8080
